Message:
smp: Optimize send_call_function_single_ipi()

Just like the ttwu_queue_remote() IPI, make use of _TIF_POLLING_NRFLAG
to avoid sending IPIs to idle CPUs.

[ mingo: Fix UP build bug. ]
